paragraph: Angola draws its electoral roll from the identity base. [Intelwatch reported in August 2026 that the roll is extracted from the civil identity database](<https://executivedigest.sapo.pt/servicos-de-informacoes-angolanos-acedem-a-dados-biometricos-sem-controlo-judicial-relatorio/>). [A Secretary of State said in September 2025 that the identity card number is also the tax number](<https://pti.ao/ministerio-da-justica-reitera-aposta-nas-tic-para-modernizar-e-simplificar-servicos/>). In the last twelve months, [a 2026 plan for the identity database](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-digitisation-angola.pdf>) lists the criminal, vehicle, commercial and land registries for integration. It does not say they will use the number. No third main register has been found using it, and no figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Benin builds its electoral list from the national register of persons. In September 2025 ANIP said [the provisional list was extracted directly from the civil status file](<https://beninwebtv.bj/affichage-de-la-liste-electorale-provisoire-lanip-lance-la-phase-de-verification/>). By 25 October 2023 [439,333 of 1,077,679 tax identifiers were attached to an NPI, 40.76%](<https://lamarina.bj/2026/11/06/benin-8-millions-de-dollars-pour-renforcer-linterconnexion-des-fichiers-fiscaux-et-didentification/>), the finance ministry said. In the last twelve months, [Since October 2026 the public-sector pension fund asks retirees for their NPI](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/1710-59862-benin-launches-app-letting-public-sector-retirees-provide-proof-of-life-remotely>) to prove they are alive. [A World Bank programme agreed in 2026 ties $8 million to linking the two files](<https://lamarina.bj/2026/11/06/benin-8-millions-de-dollars-pour-renforcer-linterconnexion-des-fichiers-fiscaux-et-didentification/>). No later share of tax identifiers linked has been found. Mature would need a figure from checking a register against the ID, such as ghost workers removed or duplicates found.

In October 2024 the minister in charge, Aminata Zerbo, said [the electoral commission would draw its voter file from the new identity base](<http://news.aouaga.com/h/155610.html>) once it is built. The base is the unique electronic identifier being built under the WURI project, with a pilot to come first. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a public register using the national ID number. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.

Botswana registers voters on Omang, the national identity card. In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the minister proposed electoral reforms that keep Omang as the primary ID for voter registration](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202608190305.html>). The same reforms would give political parties access to the verified electronic voters' roll. The roll is the one public register found using Omang. No source found since October 2023 shows the tax register, the public payroll, a social registry or the business register using it. No figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

ONECI's director general said in June 2025 that [a decree requires administrative procedures to go through the national identification number, NNI](<https://digitalmag.ci/ago-christian-kodia-le-numero-national-didentification-nni-est-lelement-principal-de-la-digitalisation-de-lidentite/>). In the same interview he said [taxpayer accounts, social security numbers and health insurance numbers are to be linked to the NNI](<https://digitalmag.ci/ago-christian-kodia-le-numero-national-didentification-nni-est-lelement-principal-de-la-digitalisation-de-lidentite/>) at very short notice. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a public register in service with the NNI. The interview gives no figure from checking a register against it. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether public registers in Cameroon use the national ID number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No electoral roll, tax register, payroll, social registry or business register has been found using the number, and no figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Preparing would need a source from the past three years showing that a public register's adoption of the national ID number is planned or piloted.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether public registers in Congo use the national ID number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No electoral roll, tax register, payroll, social registry or business register has been found using the number, and no figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Preparing would need a source from the past three years showing that a public register's adoption of the national ID number is planned or piloted.

Djibouti has made its national identification number, the NNI, compulsory for data exchange between public bodies. [The Ministry of Digital Affairs said in 2024 that all institutions must use the NNI](<https://numerique.gouv.dj/Articles/detailArticleAvancee/15>) when they exchange data. An interoperability platform with ANSIE is being set up. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a public register in service with the NNI. The statement names no electoral roll, tax register, payroll, social registry or business register. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number.

[The Interior Ministry says that in 2023 the NIN was adopted by all government bodies and partner sectors](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-decentralisation-algeria.pdf>), among them justice, banking, social security, taxation and education. Two main registers are named: social security and taxation. In the last twelve months, [the national electronic medical record is to be built around each person's identifier](<https://medica-magazine.com/lalgerie-fixe-la-date-de-la-generalisation-du-dossier-medical-numerique/>) from summer 2026. No source found since October 2023 shows the electoral roll, payroll or business register using the NIN. No figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Egypt's electoral roll is keyed on the 14-digit national number. Since 15 December 2024 [every employer files monthly payroll data on the wage tax system](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/3329890>), listing each employee's national number. In the last twelve months, in July 2026 the Tax Authority said [payroll tax for 12 million state employees is worked out from salary statements held by national number](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4306657>). In November 2026 the social solidarity ministry said [the registry is linked to 27 government databases through the national number](<https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/764443/>). That makes three main registers beside the electoral roll and payroll tax. No figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Mature would need a figure from checking a register against the ID, such as ghost workers removed or duplicates found.

Ethiopia's tax register is keyed on Fayda, the national ID. [National ID Ethiopia's May 2026 slides say the Ministry of Revenue has harmonised over 5 million existing tax numbers with Fayda](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-1-Ethiopia-FINAL.pdf>). [OpenG2P says it seeded the disaster commission's relief registry, about 300,000 people, with Fayda IDs](<https://id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P1-S2-OpenG2P-Final.pdf>) in 2025. In the last twelve months, [In November 2026 the Agricultural Transformation Institute said its farmer register, with nearly one million farmers enrolled, is linked to Fayda](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/11/08/ethiopia-targets-four-million-farmers-for-digital-registration-by-2028/>). A farmer register is not one of the five main registers. No electoral roll, payroll or business register using Fayda has been found. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement, [in force from 2 September 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099090226132027563/pdf/P175987-8dfb5a41-ff83-4fc0-a597-c588997e88ba.pdf>), provides for linking the social protection beneficiary registry and the civil servants' human resources database to the RBPP. The RBPP is the new biometric population register. In the last twelve months, the civil service minister spoke of a census of public agents in September 2026. It [had been cross-checked against the payroll and immigration directorate records](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-fonction-publique-loperation-dassainissement-du-fichier-solde-livre-ses-conclusions/>). The source does not say the payroll is keyed on the ID number. No source found shows a public register in service with the ID number. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.

Ghana's civil service payroll requires the Ghana Card PIN. [From January 2024 the Mechanized Payroll System uses the PIN to validate public sector employees and pensioners](<https://nia.gov.gh/government-launches-integrated-database-for-payroll-validation-and-verification/>). In the last twelve months, in February 2026 the Controller and Accountant-General [told staff to verify their Ghana Card details or have salaries suspended](<https://www.citinewsroom.com/2026/02/cagd-verify-ghana-card-details-by-march-15-or-face-salary-suspension/>). The household registry for social protection [collects each registrant's Ghana Card number](<https://gnhr.mogcsp.gov.gh/privacy.php>), its July 2026 privacy policy says. In September 2024 the then Vice-President said [checks against the Ghana Card removed 29,000 ghost names at SSNIT and 44,000 at the National Service Scheme](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghost-names-removed-from-government-payroll-thanks-to-ghana-card-bawumia/>). No audited figure for the civil service payroll has been found.

Guinea plans to draw its voter file from the national register of persons, the RNPP. In the last twelve months, [in January 2026 the electoral directorate, DGE, and ONECI signed a convention on it](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/01/conakry-la-dge-et-loneci-scellent-une-alliance-pour-un-fichier-electoral-fiable/>). It makes the register's data the sole official source of voter identity for the biometric electoral file. In December 2025 the directorate's head said [the voter roll will be fed from the register by a yearly extraction](<https://www.lindependant.org/actualites-etat-civil-guineen-la-refondation-en-marche-lidentification-au-coeur-du-futur-fichier-electoral/>). No source found since October 2023 shows a public register using the national ID number. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.

The Gambia's civil registration system uses the national identification number, the NIN. [In March 2024 the World Bank said the eCRVS had become the interoperability system across ministries](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/03/28/afw-transformative-journey-of-mass-birth-registration-and-health-insurance-in-the-gambia>), with the NIN as the common key. In October 2025 the revenue authority said [its new tax system will draw on the national identification database to identify taxpayers](<https://standard.gm/gra-introduces-itas-system-to-stakeholders/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No main register is shown in service using the NIN, and no figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Kenya planned the Maisha number for several registers. In May 2024 the Principal Secretary said [it would be the number used for the ID, the NSSF and the NHIF](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/digital-identity-id-roll-out-on-course-ps/>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026 the Nation reported that [it was meant at launch to be the tax and NSSF number](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/inside-new-reforms-to-curb-birth-certificate-fraud-5463104>). Both are plans. No source found since October 2023 says a public register is keyed on the national ID number, and none gives a figure from checking a register against the ID. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.

Liberia's government payroll is checked against the National Identification Registry. In February 2024 the registry said [it and the finance ministry had built an interface to audit the payroll](<https://newspublictrust.com/national-identification-registry-deploys-mobile-teams>). The Civil Service Agency's 2024 report says [5,536 employees were removed from the payroll from March to October 2024](<https://frontpageafricaonline.com/liberia-frontpage-africa-investigation-uncovers-conflicting-accounts-in-govt-payroll-cleanup/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [A 2025 study found the electoral commission and the registry keep two separate databases](<https://doi.org/10.22271/allresearch.2025.v11.i6d.12680>). The payroll is the only main register shown using the number. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Public payroll in Libya is keyed on the national number. In the last twelve months, in December 2025 the Attorney General said checks had [deleted nearly 40,000 salary numbers](<https://libyareview.com/61619/libyan-prosecutors-uncover-large-scale-identity-manipulation/>) linked to national ID numbers that do not exist. In August 2022 his office [found 8,690 citizens paid under forged national numbers](<https://alwasat.ly/news/libya/515274>). The electoral roll uses the number too. In April 2025 the election commission, HNEC, [registered 560,896 voters for municipal elections](<https://libyareview.com/54785/560896-voters-registered-for-libyan-municipal-elections/>) by SMS with their national ID number. No third main register has been found using it. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Lesotho registers voters on the national identity card. [In October 2024 the electoral commission said re-registration accepts the national ID card as the only identification](<https://publiceyenews.com/2024/10/16/800-000-ghost-voters-unearthed/>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 it said its voter registration system is linked to the national identity register](<https://sundayexpress.co.ls/?p=36187>) through unique identification numbers. [In September 2025 the minister said legal identity had strengthened the payroll and removed ghost workers](<https://www.thereporter.co.ls/2025/09/16/education-sector-lags-behind-in-id-integrationlephema/>). He gave no count. No tax or business register is shown using the number. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Mali's electoral roll is drawn from the national identification number, NINA. In January 2025 L'Essor reported that [the administrative commission enrols voters automatically](<https://lessor.ml/posts/loi-electorale-les-articles-52-57-et-70-modifies-677641a527512>) from those who hold a NINA. In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [a report on cleaning the electoral roll](<https://bamada.net/fichier-electoral-lheure-du-grand-nettoyage>) named NINA as each voter's unique identifier. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main register using NINA, and none gives a figure from checking a register against the ID. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Mauritius uses the national identity card number in its electoral register. In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the Electoral Commissioner's office said voters can check the register online](<https://electoral.govmu.org/oec/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Communique-Enregistrement-des-electeurs.pdf>) by entering their card number. [The Government Information Service says employers' National Savings Fund returns must give each employee's card number](<https://govmu.org/EN/infoservices/socialsecurity/Pages/services.aspx>) with the contributions paid. The electoral register and the fund are the two main registers shown. No source found since October 2023 shows the tax register, the public payroll or the business register using the number. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Malawi's National ID is used by several public registers. [The EU Delegation says the ID underpins voter registration, social protection targeting and payroll management](<https://www.eeas.europa.eu/delegations/malawi/10-years-fruitful-partnership-government-malawi-civil-registration_en>). In February 2025 a World Bank mission agreed [to integrate the unified beneficiary registry with the national ID system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099100325093520180/pdf/P505095-a4c66f94-3385-4c95-b175-bfa83f2438df.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 names the tax register or the business register, or gives a figure from checking a register against the ID. Mature would need a figure from checking a register against the ID, such as ghost workers removed or duplicates found.

Namibia checks social grant recipients against its population register. [The ministries responsible signed an agreement linking the National Population Registration System to the social protection system](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-namibia.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the Office of the Prime Minister said electronic ID checks stop grant payments to deceased people](<https://informante.web.na/?p=398234>). It also said the checks had saved about N$16 million. The social grants register is the one main register shown. No source found since October 2023 shows the electoral roll, tax register, payroll or business register using the ID number. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

The National Social Register used for cash transfers [requires a national identification number, NIN](<https://punchng.com/cash-transfer-fg-disqualifies-nigerians-without-nin-bvn-cbn-begins-payment/>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026 the electoral commission's chairman said [online voter registration is anchored on the NIN](<https://thenationonlineng.net/six-months-to-presidential-poll-inec-raises-preparation-tempo/>). The tax administration act [makes the NIN the tax number for individuals](<https://guardian.ng/news/nin-cac-number-to-serve-as-tax-id-firs/>) from January 2026. That gives three main registers. The social programmes agency says [1,628,587 NINs in the social register have been validated by the identity agency](<https://nsipa.gov.ng/programmes/nassco.html>). It does not say how many records the check removed or corrected. Mature would need a figure from checking a register against the ID, such as ghost workers removed or duplicates found.

Rwanda registers voters from the national ID. [The electoral commission said every such ID holder was on the final voters' list of 30 June 2024](<https://english.news.cn/africa/20240630/d53b82a4596a423cb1b5a72c86614444/c.html>). In the last twelve months, [the public-service payroll system, IPPIS, offers partner systems staff identity profiles with ID verification](<https://www.api.ippis.rw/>), its developer page says, dated October 2026. A May 2026 deck lists [the Imibereho social registry as ready to integrate with the digital ID](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-1-Rwanda-FINAL.pdf>), not yet in service. No source found since October 2023 shows the tax register or the business register using the ID number. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

In the last twelve months, an Omdurman land registration employee told Ayin Network in October 2026 that [the electronic land records can be searched by national number](<https://3ayin.com/real-estate-ownership-dispute-/>). Applications for replacement deeds carry the owner's national number. No source found since October 2023 shows the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll or business register using it. None gives a figure from checking a register against the ID. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

[In April 2024 an NCRA official said the NIN is linked to government payroll](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202404/sierra-leone-putting-digital-id-at-the-center-of-its-digital-transformation-agenda>), among other government services. In the last twelve months, [on 10 August 2026 the Electoral Commission said it would link voter registration with the NCRA identity system](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/ncra-calls-stronger-investment-in-digital/>) before the 2028 elections. [In November 2026 the National Investment Board was working with NCRA to put the NIN into business registration](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/salima-nib-online-business-registration/>). Both are plans. No source found since October 2023 shows three or more main public registers using the national ID number. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

In the last twelve months, in August 2026 the Office of the Accountant General [directed ministries and agencies to join the payroll to NIRA's identification system](<https://www.dawan.africa/news/somalia-to-link-government-payroll-to-national-id-by-end-of-2027>). A pilot in five institutions was to start on 1 October 2026. Full use is set for 31 December 2027. In January 2025 NIRA's director general said [the electoral commission is to use the ID card to check voters](<https://www.bbc.com/somali/articles/c1kmzpg73xeo>). No source found since October 2023 shows a public register using the national ID number. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.

The Camoes institute says [the Bilhete de Identidade is to become the base for permanent voter registration](<https://www.instituto-camoes.pt/sobre/comunicacao/noticias/sao-tome-e-principe>). In September 2025 the EU-funded PReSE project said [a platform being built by the University of Aveiro will link the civil registry to the roll](<https://www.telanon.info/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/NOTA-DE-IMPRENSA-1.pdf>). In the last twelve months, the institute said the electoral rolls were to be updated from civil registry data in March 2026. No source found since October 2023 shows a public register using the identity card number. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number.

A 2025 government presentation says [the Social Registry of Individuals and Households, RSPM, was in development and initial integration](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T1-P2-S1-3_TOGO-final.pdf>). It uses the e-ID as its unique key. In the last twelve months, by March 2026, the World Bank [described the e-ID as fully interoperable with the registry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099032526174532318/pdf/P169594-5fd6786a-2b45-425b-95b6-0e79d792a6fb.pdf>). The registry takes in the unique identification numbers automatically. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main register in service with the e-ID number. None gives a figure from checking a register against the ID. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

Tunisia links its sectoral identifiers to the citizen's unique identifier, the IUC. [A 2024 deck describes the same table](<https://id4africa.com/2024/ps3/PS3-3-Tunisia-Final.pdf>) as the route from sectoral identifiers to the IUC. In the last twelve months, [the 2026 country playbook says the IUC register holds health, social and pupil identifiers in a correspondence table](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). No main register has been found using the IUC, and no figure from checking a register against the ID has been found. Operating would need three or more of the electoral, tax, social protection, payroll and business registers to use the number.

[NIDA says 8.4 million taxpayer numbers had been registered using national ID numbers](<https://nida.go.tz/uploads/speeches/20260911123900_doc.pdf>) by September 2026. In the last twelve months, in September 2026 the government spokesman said [the ID number was used for taxpayer registration](<https://www.jamhurimedia.co.tz/nida-yazindua-kampeni-ya-kipo-chukua-kamilisha-safari-yako/>), TASAF social services and business registration. In November 2026 [health insurance was linked to ID numbers](<https://cioafrica.co/tanzania-unveils-new-national-id-card-and-nida-wallet/>). NIDA was still discussing tax services with the tax authority. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure from checking a register against the ID. Mature would need a figure from checking a register against the ID, such as ghost workers removed or duplicates found.

By 30 September 2026 the Uganda Revenue Authority [had linked 2.13 million of its 5.41 million individual taxpayer records to NINs](<https://ugbusiness.com/2026/10/economy/more-than-3m-tax-records-await-nin-match-before-login-switch>). In the last twelve months, Cabinet [approved the move in September 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/uganda-moves-to-make-national-digital-id-number-its-tax-identifier>) to make the NIN the tax number. In October 2025 the Daily Monitor reported that [the national voter register was compiled from biometric data taken from NIRA](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/one-man-one-vote-inside-new-ec-biometric-system-5249126>). The SAGE grant, the voter register and tax records are three main registers. The linked count does not say what checking the records found. Mature would need a figure from checking a register against the ID, such as ghost workers removed or duplicates found.

In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 Home Affairs said it had built a real-time employee verification portal for National Treasury](<https://www.gov.za/news/media-statements/home-affairs-builds-digital-verification-platform-national-treasury-combat>). The portal links to the population register to check payroll records, and the department said it would go live on 15 June 2026. In September 2025 National Treasury said [it was cross-checking the PERSAL civil service payroll with tax and population data](<https://www.itweb.co.za/article/national-treasury-deploys-tech-to-terminate-ghost-workers/GxwQDM1DWXR7lPVo>). No source found since then shows the portal in service. Establishing would need a public register to use the national ID number, such as the electoral roll, the tax register, payroll or a social registry.
